events.title: Red notification for tropical cyclone CHAMPI-26. Population affected by Category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0.29 million .
events.summary: From 14/10/2026 to 20/10/2026, a Hurricane/Typhoon > 74 mph (maximum wind speed of 269 km/h) CHAMPI-26 was active in NWPacific. The cyclone affects these countries: Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Japan (vulnerability Medium). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0.29 million .
